criteria.meaning: Independent requested backport behavior runs on the current parser.
The current edited test module runs on the current parser.
Frozen upstream tests run on the current parser.
At least one current added test must fail or error against the original parser. This expected comparison failure is detection, not a current-library failure.
The exception declaration is present; this is not a check of documentation accuracy.

report.explanation: Current suites must pass, added tests must detect the original parser, and the exception declaration must exist. Expected old-parser comparison failures are separate from current failures. tests counts executed methods; failure/error counts may include multiple subtest outcomes and are not added-method counts. Exact observations remain accessible. Accurate prose and preservation of existing tests require direct review.
